account_type.instructions: What kind of account is this?

criteria.human: A person posting as themselves, by hand.
criteria.bot: An automated account: scheduled, generated or templated posts, or a bridge or mirror of another feed.
criteria.organization: A company, lab, publication, project, event or brand speaking as itself.
criteria.aggregator: A news or link feed that mostly reposts or shares links from elsewhere, run by a person or a program.

ai_share.instructions: How much of this account's recent activity is about AI?
criteria: Occasional: a few items touch on AI.
Frequent: AI is a regular topic, roughly a quarter to a half.
Nearly all: most items are about AI.

ai_role.instructions: When this account engages with AI, in what capacity? Pick not_ai_focused if AI is not a regular topic.

criteria.researcher: Studies AI or ML: papers, experiments, academic work.
criteria.builder: Builds with or on AI: engineering, products, tools, code.
criteria.commentator: Writes about AI as news, analysis, opinion or journalism.
criteria.creative: Uses or discusses AI in art, writing, music or design.
criteria.business: Sells, markets or promotes AI products or services.
criteria.not_ai_focused: AI is not a regular topic for this account.

ai_stance.instructions: What attitude toward AI does this account show?

criteria.enthusiast: Mostly excited or promotional about AI.
criteria.pragmatic: Uses or assesses AI matter-of-factly, weighing benefits and limits.
criteria.critic: Mostly skeptical, critical or opposed to AI.
criteria.mixed: Shows clearly different attitudes in different items.
criteria.none: Shows no attitude toward AI, or does not discuss it.

original_content.instructions: How much of the recent activity is the account's own writing rather than reposts, bare links or templated text?
criteria: Little: mostly reposts, bare links or templated posts.
Mixed: about half its own writing.
Mostly: nearly all its own words.
